help.concept: The shell always has a current working directory.
help.hint_1: Use the command that prints the working directory.

course-introduction.title: The Terminal Is a Text Interface
course-introduction.bodyMarkdown: A terminal lets you control the computer by typing commands instead of clicking through windows. A command asks the shell to perform one specific action.

terminal-command-output.title: Commands Produce Results
terminal-command-output.bodyMarkdown: Type a command, press Enter, and read the result before continuing. Some commands print information; others change the current terminal state.

prompt-and-command.title: Prompt Versus Command
prompt-and-command.bodyMarkdown: The prompt shows that the terminal is ready for input. Type your command after the prompt; do not copy the prompt itself.
